LESSON: TWO-PART HARMONY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: MUSIC AND DANCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Foundations of Music and Dance
Topic 1.5: Two-Part Harmony
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Two-Part Harmony, part of Foundations of Music and Dance in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 MUSIC AND DANCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What is harmony? 2. What do you consider when adding a second part to an existing melody?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to two-part vocal and/or instrumental harmonic passages in major keys to identify guidelines used in two-part harmony,

2. sing, hum/mime and/ or play 2-part harmonic passages in major keys to aurally discriminate the higher and lower parts in the passages. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to two-part vocal and/or instrumental harmonic passages in major keys to identify guidelines used in two-part harmony,
2. sing, hum/mime and/ or play 2-part harmonic passages in major keys to aurally discriminate the higher and lower parts in the passages. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Two-Part Harmony together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner speaks/mime clearly and effectively when describing harmonic

intervals.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner comes up with new musical ideas when composing the second part to a 4-bar

melody.

• Digital Literacy: The learner records the 2-part music using a digital device.

Values:
• Respect: The learner recognizes the input of every member of the team as they participate in group activities involving

sounding harmonic intervals.

• Integrity: The learner uses own music ideas without plagiarism.

• Unity: The learner collaborates with others in sounding harmonic intervals in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

• Cyber security: The learner uses digital devices responsibly as they record the 2-part music.

20

• Safety and security: The learner takes precaution while interacting with digital devices.

• Self-esteem: The learner gains confidence as they compose music.

Suggested Learning Resources

Sheet music, Melodic and Harmonic instruments, Flash cards of two-part harmony, portfolios, anecdotal records,

manuscripts audio/visual recordings of harmonies, Pitching device, Song book, ICT devices, Internet connectivity and
